description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy results (in percent) for two benchmarks, MMAU and MMAR, across three model categories. The horizontal axis contains the model names, ordered left to right as “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” with each category showing a pair of adjacent bars. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals. For each model, the MMAU bar is shown in blue and the MMAR bar is shown in purple, as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. For “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” the blue MMAU bar is approximately 49% and the purple MMAR bar is approximately 30%. For “Audio-Reasoner,” the blue MMAU bar is approximately 61% and the purple MMAR bar is approximately 36%. For “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” the blue MMAU bar is approximately 65% and the purple MMAR bar is approximately 56%. The bars are grouped by model with consistent color coding for the two benchmarks, there is no stacking, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the standard legend and coloring.
